# T-4: Resolve bounded review actions

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make definition, retry reset, next-action, and status derive one permitted review recovery operation from persisted semantic and tooling state.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Review nodes expose toolingMaxAttempts=1 separately from semantic maxAttempts.
- retry_review, register_alternative_evidence, move_to_acceptance, and stop_as_blocker are selected deterministically with accurate remaining attempts.
- next-action and status expose one reviewAction with exclusive handoff/blocker payload and no authoritative reviewStop plus retryRecovery pair.
- set retry reset review rejects unchanged identity and permits revalidation only after tree SHA or canonical evidence changes.

## Implementation Notes
Centralize ordering in the operation resolver; get-next-action and get-status are projections and must not duplicate policy branches.

## Test Strategy
Table-driven spec-local tests cover every operation branch, attempt boundary, unchanged reset, changed-tree reset, repeated reads, and autoApprove permission separation.
